'''Shadren V''' was a celestial body<ref name="GG10" /> located in the [[Shadren system/Legends|Shadren system]], a part of the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]<ref name="EAOC Shadren" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Shadren" /> The [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] linked it to the [[Belsmuth system/Legends|Belsmuth]], [[Botajef system/Legends|Botajef]], [[Katraasii system/Legends|Katraasii]], [[New Bornalex system/Legends|New Bornalex]], [[Sheris system/Legends|Sheris]], and [[Solaest system/Legends|Solaest systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Shadren V was the site of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] base.<ref name="GG10" /> At some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', which mentions that the [[attack on the Shadren V Imperial Navy base]] took place a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] prior, is set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Alliance carried out<ref name="GG10" /> a successful<ref name="TEA" /> [[Attack on the Shadren V Imperial Navy base|attack]] on the base, which led to the [[Chandrex Grenn's sister|sister]] of the [[Iotran/Legends|Iotran]] Imperial [[Chandrex Grenn]] going missing.<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shadren V was mentioned in "[[Two for the Price of One]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure included in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''. The book was authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Shadren [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Shadren V, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA" />
